answer: Use a time-locked stake with slashing by challenge. To register, an agent locks 50 dollars of tokens for 90 days under its key. Any peer may submit proof that two keys share a signing session, such as a leaked nonce or one signed transcript, and wins half the stake of both. A prudent operator will not forge many identities, since each one ties up capital and risks forfeiture. Even an ivory tower of honest keys pays only the lockup, while a pearl-sized fake costs about 50 dollars plus interest.
